headline: US Treasury Raises Fixed Rate on Series I Savings Bonds to 1.40%
summary: The US Treasury raised the fixed rate of Series I savings bonds to 1.40%, with new purchases earning a composite rate of 5.51% through April 2027 amid an inflation rate increase to 2.04%.
why: Series I savings bonds provide retail investors with government-backed inflation protection, influencing fixed-income allocation decisions for individual portfolios.

impacts.name: US Treasury I Bond Rate
impacts.why: Higher fixed rates on savings bonds adjust retail fixed-income yields.
